description: Put back what a write replaced — a page or form edit made here (sb_add, sb_set, sb_duplicate …), or a PUT through sb_api_call. An undo records what IT replaced, so the newest entry right after one is its redo. A page is refused if anyone else saved it since. IN THIS PROCESS ONLY, capped; the platform's own page history (GET .../pages/{pageId}/history) survives a restart. No argument lists what is undoable.
name: sb_undo
